atticSnapshot.capture: pre-C, before base-page relocation and BSS initialization
atticSnapshot.integrity: CRC32 over all 5632 payload bytes plus both 16-byte 0xa5 guards; validate before KERNAL entry and before restore
atticSnapshot.lifetime: PRE_C_CAPTURED through KERNAL_CONTEXT_RESTORED in one run; invalidated before SERVICES_RESUMED
atticSnapshot.access: protected proof-platform assembly only; fixed generated bounds; no arbitrary Attic pointer reaches C

protectedResidentRule.rule: Any code and data or constant state required while a temporary 0x8000-0xbfff MAP window is active must remain accessible and may not be hidden by that mapping.
protectedResidentRule.t02Placement: The T02 protected transition and canonical-restoration code has no separate protected data/constant section and is linker-constrained below 0x008000.
protectedResidentRule.ordinaryWorkloadPlacement: Ordinary successor workload code may remain in the admitted 0x002001-0x00bfff resident envelope and need not be moved below 0x008000.

lifecycleRules: Every normal event equals the current state and advances exactly one state.
Any out-of-order event, failed guard/CRC, NMI, outstanding application DMA, unmasked IRQ, failed ROM restoration, storage error or failed canonical restoration enters LOCKOUT.
Storage is admitted only in APPLICATION_SAVED with ROM restored, valid snapshot, empty application DMA and IRQ masked.
Resume is admitted only after KERNAL and application context restoration, canonical B=2/port=0x35/MAP/vector state, and invalidation of the Attic transition snapshot.
The 100 Hz clock and 21-stage simulation order are stopped at the lifecycle boundary and resume at the next tick; no tick is merged, advanced or reconstructed during storage.
restorationOrder: quiesce workload and complete application DMA
preserve application low memory, hardware stack, base page and DOS overlay
validate Attic KERNAL context guards and CRC
restore opaque KERNAL context and saved KERNAL-entry DOS context
restore opaque KERNAL context, application DOS overlay, low memory, hardware stack and base page
restore canonical MAP, B=2, port 0x35, vectors and service state
invalidate transition snapshot and resume at the next authoritative tick
nonClaims: runtime or physical proof of Attic snapshot behavior
measured limits or full R0-F acceptance
